children: RTX unit Raytheon Missiles and Defense received a $511.5 million modification to a U.S. Navy contract covering hardware production of the AN/SPY-6(V) family of radars.
Work on the contract is expected to be complete by November 2031, though it could continue through that month if all options are exercised, the Pentagon said Wednesday.
Write to Elias Schisgall at elias.schisgall@wsj.com
